set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem ternary_coupled_reciprocal_strict
  (d n : ℕ) (a b c : ℝ)
  (hdigits : Nat.digits 3 n = [d, 2, 2, 1])
  (hpos : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c)
  (hne : ¬ (a = b ∧ b = c))
  (htotal : a + b + c = (n : ℝ)) :
  9 / ((d : ℝ) + 51) < 2 / (a + b) + 2 / (b + c) + 2 / (c + a) := by
  have h_ofDigits : Nat.ofDigits 3 (Nat.digits 3 n) = n := Nat.ofDigits_digits 3 n
  rw [hdigits] at h_ofDigits
  have hn_val : (n : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) + 51 := by
    have : Nat.ofDigits 3 [d, 2, 2, 1] = d + 51 := by
      simp [Nat.ofDigits]
    rw [← h_ofDigits, this]
    push_cast
    ring
  
  have hab : 0 < a + b := by linarith [hpos.1, hpos.2.1]
  have hbc : 0 < b + c := by linarith [hpos.2.1, hpos.2.2]
  have hca : 0 < c + a := by linarith [hpos.1, hpos.2.2]
  have habc : 0 < a + b + c := by linarith [hpos.1, hpos.2.1, hpos.2.2]
  
  have h_sq_sum : 0 < (a + b) * (a - b)^2 + (b + c) * (b - c)^2 + (c + a) * (c - a)^2 := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (a + b) * (a - b)^2 := by positivity
    have h2 : 0 ≤ (b + c) * (b - c)^2 := by positivity
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (c + a) * (c - a)^2 := by positivity
    have h_cases : a ≠ b ∨ b ≠ c := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact hne hc
    cases h_cases with
    | inl hab_ne =>
      have : 0 < (a - b)^2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr hab_ne)
      have : 0 < (a + b) * (a - b)^2 := mul_pos hab this
      linarith
    | inr hbc_ne =>
      have : 0 < (b - c)^2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr hbc_ne)
      have : 0 < (b + c) * (b - c)^2 := mul_pos hbc this
      linarith
  
  have h_ident : (2 / (a + b) + 2 / (b + c) + 2 / (c + a) - 9 / (a + b + c)) *
      ((a + b) * (b + c) * (c + a) * (a + b + c)) =
      (a + b) * (a - b)^2 + (b + c) * (b - c)^2 + (c + a) * (c - a)^2 := by
    have hab_ne : a + b ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hbc_ne : b + c ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hca_ne : c + a ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have habc_ne : a + b + c ≠ 0 := by linarith
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have h_denom : 0 < (a + b) * (b + c) * (c + a) * (a + b + c) := by positivity
  
  have h_sub_pos : 0 < 2 / (a + b) + 2 / (b + c) + 2 / (c + a) - 9 / (a + b + c) := by
    rw [← mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right h_denom, h_ident]
    exact h_sq_sum
  
  have h_main : 9 / (a + b + c) < 2 / (a + b) + 2 / (b + c) + 2 / (c + a) := by linarith
  rw [htotal, hn_val] at h_main

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem ternary_coupled_reciprocal_strict
  (d n : ℕ) (a b c : ℝ)
  (hdigits : Nat.digits 3 n = [d, 2, 2, 1])
  (hpos : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c)
  (hne : ¬ (a = b ∧ b = c))
  (htotal : a + b + c = (n : ℝ)) :
  9 / ((d : ℝ) + 51) < 2 / (a + b) + 2 / (b + c) + 2 / (c + a) := by
  have hn_eq : n = d + 51 := by
    have h1 : n = Nat.ofDigits 3 (Nat.digits 3 n) := (Nat.ofDigits_digits 3 n).symm
    rw [hdigits] at h1
    simp [Nat.ofDigits] at h1
    omega
  have hn_real : (n : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) + 51 := by
    exact_mod_cast hn_eq
  have ha : 0 < a := hpos.1
  have hb : 0 < b := hpos.2.1
  have hc : 0 < c := hpos.2.2
  have hab : 0 < a + b := add_pos ha hb
  have hbc : 0 < b + c := add_pos hb hc
  have hca : 0 < c + a := add_pos hc ha
  have hab_ne : a + b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hab
  have hbc_ne : b + c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hbc
  have hca_ne : c + a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hca
  have habc : 0 < a + b + c := add_pos (add_pos ha hb) hc
  have habc_ne : a + b + c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt habc
  
  have h_id : (a + b + c) * (2 / (a + b) + 2 / (b + c) + 2 / (c + a)) - 9 =
      (a - c) ^ 2 / ((a + b) * (b + c)) +
      (b - a) ^ 2 / ((b + c) * (c + a)) +
      (c - b) ^ 2 / ((c + a) * (a + b)) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have h_sq1 : 0 ≤ (a - c) ^ 2 / ((a + b) * (b + c)) :=
    div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hab) (le_of_lt hbc))
  have h_sq2 : 0 ≤ (b - a) ^ 2 / ((b + c) * (c + a)) :=
    div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hbc) (le_of_lt hca))
  have h_sq3 : 0 ≤ (c - b) ^ 2 / ((c + a) * (a + b)) :=
    div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hca) (le_of_lt hab))
  
  have h_not_all_zero : ¬ (a - c = 0 ∧ b - a = 0 ∧ c - b = 0) := by
    intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hac, hba, -⟩
    apply hne
    constructor
    · linarith
    · linarith
  
  have h_pos_sum : 0 < (a - c) ^ 2 / ((a + b) * (b + c)) +
      (b - a) ^ 2 / ((b + c) * (c + a)) +
      (c - b) ^ 2 / ((c + a) * (a + b)) := by
    by_contra h_le
    push_neg at h_le
    have h1_zero : (a - c) ^ 2 / ((a + b) * (b + c)) = 0 := by linarith
    have h2_zero : (b - a) ^ 2 / ((b + c) * (c + a)) = 0 := by linarith
    have h3_zero : (c - b) ^ 2 / ((c + a) * (a + b)) = 0 := by linarith
    have h_denom1 : (a + b) * (b + c) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hab_ne hbc_ne
    have h_denom2 : (b + c) * (c + a) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hbc_ne hca_ne
    have h_denom3 : (c + a) * (a + b) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hca_ne hab_ne
    have sq1_zero : (a - c) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp h1_zero).resolve_right h_denom1
    have sq2_zero : (b - a) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp h2_zero).resolve_right h_denom2
    have sq3_zero : (c - b) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp h3_zero).resolve_right h_denom3
    have diff1 : a - c = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp sq1_zero
    have diff2 : b - a = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp sq2_zero
    have diff3 : c - b = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp sq3_zero
    exact h_not_all_zero ⟨diff1, diff2, diff3⟩
  
  have h_mul_gt : 9 < (a + b + c) * (2 / (a + b) + 2 / (b + c) + 2 / (c + a)) := by
    linarith [h_id]
  
  have h_div : 9 / (a + b + c) < 2 / (a + b) + 2 / (b + c) + 2 / (c + a) := by
    exact (div_lt_iff₀ habc).mpr (by linarith [h_mul_gt])
  
  rw [htotal, hn_real] at h_div
  exact h_div
